Name: Wildflour's Witchy Greenhouse Map
Author: Wildflourmods
Description:
[font=Tahoma][size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/xOnA2oQ.png[/img]
[/size][/font][center][font=Tahoma][size=4]
new interior greenhouse maps for the witchy farmer!

[b]choose from 3 layouts:[/b]

Original layout has room for both crops and trees

TreesOnly is just trees, 60 spots

CropsOnly is just crops, with 240 tillable tiles

all include "The Mush Room" , a small secret map through the wizard tower in that has space for 6 quality sprinklers, perfect for growing mushrooms or other cave crops

recolor compatible!
[/size][/font][/center][font=Tahoma][size=4]
﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/cNjfrI3.png[/img]

Hime for being my other half and for crafting us these amazing tilesheets to use.

SDV modding discord community for their continued love and support and friendship.[img]https://i.imgur.com/T0uVb7A.png[/img]

[i][center]Can not be used with another mod that changes the greenhouse interior map[/center][/i][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/WrSO1e5.png[/img]

[url=https://ko-fi.com/wildflourmods]Ko-fi.com/wildflourmods[/url]
